datasets.name: LISS-3 satellite imagery of western India (Maharashtra and Goa)
datasets.verbatim: We collected the scalable real-time pre-landslide and post-landslide RS images of western India landslide regions (Maharashtra and Goa) directly from the Linear Imaging Self Scanning (LISS-3) satellite in the Bhuvan web portal “https://bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in/home/index.php”.

methods.name: CNN-LSTM
methods.summary: A framework that uses a lightweight CNN (based on ResNet50 with modified layers) for automatic feature extraction from pre-processed RS images, followed by an LSTM classifier for landslide prediction. Post-processing uses morphological operations and dynamic segmentation for landslide localization.

availability.author_statement: Stated as 'Data sharing not applicable to this article as no datasets were generated or analyzed during the current study.'

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom CNN-LSTM code is not available via any repository or persistent link.
